crossRefs.note: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to…
Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to…
PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”
Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.
They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
